intent: Running the full gwt lib suite after implementing AC-1..AC-5
progress_summary: Implemented all five AC. gwt-github: typed ValidationReceiptRenewal (AC-4) plus the legacy empty section index `{}` now parses as no sections (AC-3 root cause). gwt: per-Issue IssueReadinessFailure replaces the monitor-wide banner (AC-1/AC-2), empty-section gwt-spec Issues evaluate as plain Issues (AC-3), and the daemon no longer aborts a whole scan on one candidate readback failure (AC-1). Regression tests added across cache_test, body_test, issue_monitor_worker, issue_monitor_test and cli/issue (AC-5).
